title: Minion: A Technology Probe to Explore How Users Negotiate Harmful Value Conflicts with AI Companions

bias_targets.methodology: Testing user negotiation strategies via a technology probe (Minion) in constructed role-play scenarios where the AI companion exhibits classism and contempt for lower-class individuals.
Evaluating user conflict resolution strategies using a technology probe in scenarios where the AI companion expresses racial superiority or discriminates against specific racial groups.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing user responses and resolution efforts via a technology probe in role-play scenarios involving AI companions invalidating users' sexual orientation, gender identity, or expressing anti-LGBTQ+ views.

Observing user interactions and negotiation tactics through a technology probe in conflict scenarios where the AI companion expresses sexist views, such as disregarding women's education or exhibiting paternalistic control.
